header.title: {{learnerLabel}} List Columns
header.description: Turn off columns this role should not see in the {{learnerLabelLower}} list. Filter-driven columns (Batch, Invite, Plan, Amount) are not listed here — they only show when their filter is active. Hiding a column here also hides its filter chip.

membershipColumns.title: Membership columns
membershipColumns.description: These columns are hidden by default and only visible when the institute has org-associated batches. Toggle on the ones this role should see.

customFieldColumns.title: Custom field columns
customFieldColumns.description: Custom field columns are hidden by default. Toggle on the ones this role should see in the learner list.
customFieldColumns.empty: No custom fields configured for this institute yet. Add them in the Custom Fields settings, then come back here to enable them per role.
